title: Add options to disable COUNT on menuSelect widget
body: The menuSelect widget does not have any way to disable the COUNT. There is no CSS selector to hide it or any parameter to enable or disable it when adding the widget. This is what gets render: `` it will be nice to have it like this: ````

comments.body:
We do not have children inside an `option` because the HTML doesn't support this behaviour. The only type of content allowed in an `option` element is a [Text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-option-element) node.

But you can implement your own widget with the [`connectMenu`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectMenu.html) connector. The connector API lets you have the full control on the rendering of your widgets. You can find more information about that [in the documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/customization.html).
